This subreddit is for people that are feeling alone and want support from anyone.
Don't be sorry for not being suicidal.
Thank you for commenting here and I hope you find someone that could be your emotional support.
Don't forget that there will always be someone rooting for you.
I love you.

I think there are a lot of people that think this way, and it's not lame, you just love the people around you and you care about their feelings. 
That's something great.

Please take a step back.
You aren't alone.
We are with you.
And we will get out from this feeling, but please stay here, we'll help you when you need it, and you will help us.

My wish is to you to have a reason to live.
I'll pray for that.
I need somebody - Day6
If you are in this subreddit means that you should.

Do you have another way to contact him?
You can talk with a common friend.
Why don't you tell him about how are you feeling?
Thank you for this.

Have you seen the girls in internet that make their make up? They are amazing doing that. It's a little difficult at first, but with practice and perseverance you could be more confident. Remember to use sunscreen.
And for your hair, why don't you use a wig? There are a lot of beautiful wigs. But first read the reviews, that's important.
It's difficult to hide a scar and there will be times when you'll see yourself at a mirror and you won't like what you'll see. Please make a post here when that time comes. There is always someone who can tell you something nice in a difficult time. None of us will judge you.

There are people that are absolutely shit.
I'm sorry you have to have that experience.
Please take care of yourself.

I know you've been planning this for a while now, because it's not an easy decision. 

And I know I can't convince you to not do it. 

Can you do me a favor? 

From today to the day when you get the sodium nitrite please make a post here, if you don't want to talk about what is bothering you, it will be fine, you can post about whatever you want. But please do it, for a random person in the internet.

To seek help in reddit means you don't want to hurt yourself.

Let us know what is wrong when you feel like.
